Emerson Delgado  
Member ID: W249568388  
Simply Healthcare Commercial/ACA Plan, Florida  

Date: [Date sent]

To: Simply Healthcare Commercial/ACA Appeals Department  
[Appeal mailing address, fax number, or electronic submission instructions]

Re: Appeal of denial for rotator cuff repair  
CPT 29827  
Reference number: POC-926BF4D7E4-25977  
Date of denial notice: August 25, 2026

Dear Appeals Reviewer:

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for arthroscopic rotator cuff repair, CPT 29827. The denial states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity.

The available clinical record documents the following:

- I have had 18 months of progressive shoulder pain that has not improved with rest.
- I completed 16 supervised physical-therapy visits over eight weeks, from May 10, 2026, through July 5, 2026. Therapy focused on rotator-cuff strengthening and scapular mechanics, as documented in the physical-therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for eight months without adequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on May 30, 2026, provided only four weeks of partial relief.
- MRI on June 18, 2026, showed a full-thickness supraspinatus tear measuring 1.8 cm, with grade 2 fatty atrophy.
- My symptoms substantially impair function: I cannot raise the affected arm above shoulder height and cannot sleep on the affected side.
- Examination documented positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.
- The record documents no active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI 29, and nonsmoking status.
- The treating surgeon is Duval, MD, an orthopedic surgeon.

This documentation establishes a confirmed structural rotator-cuff tear, persistent and functionally limiting symptoms, failure of extensive conservative treatment, and objective examination and MRI findings supporting the requested repair. It also addresses relevant medical and surgical risk information.

Please reconsider the denial and authorize CPT 29827. If the plan believes additional information is required, please identify each specific missing document or clinical fact and allow my treating surgeon to submit it. Please also arrange a peer-to-peer review with Duval, MD if that is available.

The public materials I was able to locate do not identify the exact Commercial/ACA medical policy or clinical review criteria applied to this case. Therefore, this appeal does not quote or attribute any criteria to the plan. Please provide the exact policy or clinical-review document used for this determination, including its title, policy number, version or effective date, and the specific criteria applied to CPT 29827. Please also provide the clinical rationale explaining why the submitted records were considered insufficient.

Please confirm receipt of this appeal and advise me if any additional information is required. This appeal is being submitted before the deadline stated in the denial notice, February 21, 2027.

Sincerely,

Emerson Delgado
